# UniMAP Academic Timetable · Semester 1 2026/2027

> Official academic timetable for Universiti Malaysia Perlis (UniMAP), Faculty of Electronic Engineering Technology (FKTE), Programme UR6522002, Year 2 Group 3 (Y2G3).

## Overview
- **Institution**: Universiti Malaysia Perlis (UniMAP)
- **Faculty**: Faculty of Electronic Engineering Technology (FKTE)
- **Programme**: UR6522002 (Year 2, Group 3 / Y2G3)
- **Academic Term**: Semester 1, 2026/2027
- **Total Class Hours**: 23 hours per week
- **Total Subjects**: 5 core subjects
- **First Class of Week**: Tuesday at 11:00 AM
- **Last Class of Week**: Friday at 5:00 PM (17:00)
- **Note**: English, Malay and Philosophy classes are omitted from this timetable.

## Weekly Schedule Day-by-Day

### Monday
- **Status**: Free day (No classes scheduled). Allocated for independent study, revision, and assignments.

### Tuesday (5 class hours)
1. **11:00 – 14:00 (3 hours)**: Control System Technology (Lab)
   - **Course Code**: EMK22003 / EMK31103
   - **Venue**: FKTE 2 · Industrial Control Lab
   - **Lecturers**: Mazwin Binti Mazlan, Mardianaliza Binti Othman
2. *14:00 – 15:00*: Free Time (1 hour)
3. **15:00 – 17:00 (2 hours)**: Mathematics for Eng. Technology 3 (Lecture)
   - **Course Code**: IMQ21303
   - **Venue**: Pauh Putra · Dewan Kuliah 3 (DK 3)
   - **Lecturer**: Zabidi Bin Abu Hasan

### Wednesday (4 class hours)
1. **10:00 – 11:00 (1 hour)**: Mathematics for Eng. Technology 3 (Lecture · Online)
   - **Course Code**: IMQ21303
   - **Venue**: Online
   - **Lecturer**: Zabidi Bin Abu Hasan
2. **11:00 – 14:00 (3 hours)**: Electronics 2 (Lab)
   - **Course Code**: EMK21303
   - **Venue**: FKTE 2 · Power Electronics Lab
   - **Lecturers**: Chanuri A/P Charin, Abdul Rahim Bin Abdul Razak

### Thursday (10 class hours)
1. **08:00 – 10:00 (2 hours)**: Electric Circuit Theory 2 (Lecture C)
   - **Course Code**: EMK21203
   - **Venue**: FKTE 2 · Bilik Kuliah 1 (BK 1)
   - **Lecturer**: Mohamad Zhafran Bin Zakariya
2. *10:00 – 11:00*: Free Time (1 hour)
3. **11:00 – 14:00 (3 hours)**: Electric Circuit Theory 2 (Lab)
   - **Course Code**: EMK21203
   - **Venue**: FKTE 2 · Electrical Machines Simulator Lab
   - **Lecturers**: Mohamad Zhafran Bin Zakariya, Junaidah Binti Ali Mohd Jobran
4. **14:00 – 17:00 (3 hours)**: Measurement & Instrumentation (Lab)
   - **Course Code**: EMK21103
   - **Venue**: FKTE 2 · Electrical Technology Lab
   - **Lecturers**: Muhammad Shakir Bin Laili, Chanuri A/P Charin
5. **17:00 – 19:00 (2 hours)**: Measurement & Instrumentation (Lecture A)
   - **Course Code**: EMK21103
   - **Venue**: Pauh Putra · Dewan Kuliah 4 (DK 4)
   - **Lecturer**: Muhammad Shakir Bin Laili

### Friday (4 class hours)
1. **08:00 – 10:00 (2 hours)**: Electronics 2 (Lecture A)
   - **Course Code**: EMK21303
   - **Venue**: Pauh Putra · Dewan Kuliah 3 (DK 3)
   - **Lecturers**: Chanuri A/P Charin, Abdul Rahim Bin Abdul Razak
2. *10:00 – 15:00*: Break (including Friday prayer & lunch break 12:00 – 15:00)
3. **15:00 – 17:00 (2 hours)**: Control System Technology (Lecture A)
   - **Course Code**: EMK22003 / EMK31103
   - **Venue**: Pauh Putra · Dewan Kuliah 5 (DK 5)
   - **Lecturer**: Mazwin Binti Mazlan
